top_10_improvements.title: Silent failure swallowing
top_10_improvements.description: Sentiment failures are silently logged and discarded. Add retry with backoff, dead-letter queue for permanently-failed documents, and a SENTIMENT_FAILED processing state so operators can identify and reprocess affected documents.

top_10_improvements.title: Remove mock fallback from production
top_10_improvements.description: use_mock=True generates random labels and scores. This corrupts downstream Risk, Reputation, and Narrative data. Production must fail hard on model load failure - no mock fallback.

top_10_improvements.title: Add unique constraint on document_sentiments(document_id)
top_10_improvements.description: Without this, Celery task retries or duplicate task submissions create multiple sentiment rows per document. Enforce at DB level and use upsert logic in SentimentAnalyzer.

top_10_improvements.title: Add explainability metadata column
top_10_improvements.description: Store a JSONB sentiment_metadata column with: context_window text, entity_name (entity sentiment), raw_model_output, truncation_applied (bool), model_version. Mirrors the Phase 1.2 match_metadata pattern.

top_10_improvements.title: Implement batch inference
top_10_improvements.description: Current code calls analyze_text once per document + once per entity mention. Batch all texts in a single pipeline() call. Mirrors Phase 2.3 optimization that yielded +114% throughput.

top_10_improvements.title: Add structured logging on success
top_10_improvements.description: Emit a structlog event on sentiment completion with: document_id, client_id, label, confidence_score, entity_count, latency_ms, model_name.

top_10_improvements.title: Add document processing state for sentiment
top_10_improvements.description: Extend the document state machine with SENTIMENT_PENDING, SENTIMENT_PROCESSING, SENTIMENT_COMPLETE, SENTIMENT_FAILED states. Documents stuck in SENTIMENT_FAILED become requeue-able.

top_10_improvements.title: Confidence threshold gating
top_10_improvements.description: Documents classified below 0.55 confidence should be marked SENTIMENT_LOW_CONFIDENCE instead of writing a low-quality label to drive high-stakes decisions.

top_10_improvements.title: Fix source_reliability hardcoding
top_10_improvements.description: source_reliability is always 1.0. Join to the Source model and use a configurable reliability score per source, cascading correctly to weighted_sentiment_score and risk calculations.

top_10_improvements.title: Improve entity context windowing
top_10_improvements.description: Current windowing uses first-occurrence-only and a fixed 100-char window. Use all occurrences, aggregate context scores, and increase window to 200 chars.
